title: Information Disclosure and Competitive Dynamics: Evidence from the Pharmaceutical Industry
near_miss_reason: Time-varying trial-level controls in every reported column: Table 3 columns 1 and 4 add only the phase indicators p2 and p3, columns 2-3 and 5-6 add log enrollment, duration, market size and sponsor experience, and the Figure 2 event study and Table 4 carry the same controls; Table 2 uses a continuous competition measure and is not the binary design. Otherwise a staggered binary design (post_pr_app = a competitor priority-review drug approved in the trial's 9-digit MeSH market, approval years varying across markets, never-treated markets present) on a repeated cross-section of trials with MeSH-market and start-year FE, clustered by market. Controls are the sole violation (5c candidate), but the Cortellis trial data are proprietary and not shipped.
eligible_reason: The design qualifies structurally (binary post_pr_app = a competitor priority-review drug has been approved in the trial's 9-digit MeSH market, with approval years varying across markets; repeated cross-section of trials assigned to MeSH units with MeSH and start-year FE; never-treated markets present), but every reported column includes trial-level covariates: at minimum phase indicators (p2 p3), and most add enrollment, duration, market size and sponsor experience. Marked not eligible under the no-controls rule as a near-miss; flag for lead review. Replication is infeasible anyway: the package has only programs and logs (Cortellis data are proprietary).
design_notes: From Programs/prepare_analytic.do, table3.do, figure2.do and Logs. Observation: trial x MeSH (nct_id, mesh9), phase II/II-III/III trials started 2007-2019 (analytic_trial.dta, 147,413 rows; 78,938 industry-funded). Unit FE: mesh_id (9-digit MeSH code); time FE: start_year. Treatment post_pr_app = 1 if a competitor priority-review drug was approved in the MeSH before the trial start (pre_pr_app marks trials in ever-treated markets before approval; pr_app_year = approval year); treat = post_pr_app | pre_pr_app identifies ever-treated markets. Table 3 (ind==1): col 1/4 reghdfe result_year2 / ln_result_time post_pr_app p2 p3, absorb(mesh_id start_year) cluster(mesh_id); cols 2-3/5-6 add ln_enrollment ln_duration ln_diag (+ missing flags) and ln_firm_exp. Figure 2: event study with two-year bins (-5..-1, 1..7 relative to approval year minus one) plus controls. Table 2 uses continuous ln_competition. Table 4 / Figures 3-4: subsamples and treatment subtypes (same/different technology) with controls.
